description: A cairn capstone of the old kings set in a sheath of the Frostbound's ice on a haft bound with titan iron, worked cold at Last Hearth's forge. It does not warm in the hand. Its heavy blows chill what they strike: it slows, and the cold takes hold of it.

perk.text: Heavies chill whatever they strike: slowed by 35% for 3 s
